name: Vault of Ironforge
summary: In Ironforge's Commons, citizens and Alliance travelers bring their wealth to the Vault. It is the city's primary bank and treasure house, overseen by Dinita and the Stonemantle family.

sections.title: Heart of Dwarven Commerce
sections.body: You find the Vault in the Commons, where travelers, soldiers, and merchants bring coin, relics, and provisions for safekeeping. City guards and tellers watch over its work. Dinita and the Stonemantle family oversee the bank, where citizens and Alliance visitors keep their wealth secure.

faq.q: What is the Vault of Ironforge used for?
faq.answer: The Vault is Ironforge's central bank and treasure storehouse. Citizens and Alliance travelers rely on it to keep gold, gear, and prized possessions safe within the mountain.
Dinita and members of the Stonemantle family operate the bank, managing deposits, transactions, and storage for visitors.
The Vault is in Ironforge's Commons, directly across from the Auction House.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can take pride in the Vault's reputation for safeguarding dwarven wealth within the mountain.
Across from Ironforge's Auction House, the Vault helps Alliance adventurers keep their gold and supplies close at hand.
